# cubepath_lb_listener (Resource)

Manages a load balancer listener on CubePath Cloud.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `loadbalancer_id` (String) The UUID of the load balancer.
- `name` (String) The name of the listener.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol: http, https, tcp, or tls.
- `source_port` (Number) The port to listen on.
- `target_port` (Number) The port to forward traffic to.

### Optional

- `algorithm` (String) Load balancing algorithm: round_robin, least_conn, or source.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the listener is enabled.
- `sticky_sessions` (Boolean) Enable sticky sessions.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UUID of the listener.
